item.title: RoundSignal 2026-W32: 9 freshly-funded accounts to sell to this week
item.description:
RoundSignal Issue 2026-W32

Freshly-funded B2B SaaS & tech startups (pre-seed -> Series B)

9 trigger-ready accounts, scored and contextualized.

inforcer

heat 88

Trigger: $50M Series C led by Insight Partners (Meritech, Dawn Capital), Tech.eu, as of 30 Jul 2026

Why now: A $50M Series C means inforcer is scaling its AI security platform for MSPs fast and will be hiring and building GTM infrastructure — prime timing for RevOps, growth, recruiting and dev services.

Who to contact: VP Marketing / Head of Growth or COO · info@inforcer.com

Angle: Reference their Microsoft-security-for-MSP wedge and offer a channel-partner demand-gen playbook to convert Series C dollars into MSP pipeline within the quarter.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Centralize

heat 85

Trigger: $15M Series A (Crunchbase exclusive), founders ex-Meta/Slack, as of 29 Jul 2026

Why now: Just emerged from stealth with $15M to build a 'Deal GPS' for enterprise sales — they'll be scaling engineering and their own GTM motion immediately, a fit for dev, design and RevOps sellers.

Who to contact: Co-founder / CEO or Head of Engineering

Angle: Congratulate on the stealth-to-Series-A launch and offer to help them dogfood their own enterprise sales motion with a fractional RevOps sprint while they hire.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Atomic One

heat 80

Trigger: €5.6M two-tranche round (Arcano Partners), EU-Startups, as of 31 Jul 2026

Why now: Fresh €5.6M to scale an AI operating system for e-commerce brands means expansion in product and commercial teams — a clean fit for growth/marketing, dev and recruiting providers.

Who to contact: CEO / Head of Growth · hello@atomicone.ai

Angle: Open with a specific angle on scaling AI-agent onboarding for e-com brands and offer a launch-marketing package tied to their post-raise commercial push.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Intropy

heat 79

Trigger: $11M seed led by Felix Capital, Tech.eu, as of 30 Jul 2026

Why now: London-based AI-for-spare-parts startup raised $11M and is explicitly targeting US expansion — perfect window for recruiting, PR and growth support as they enter a new market.

Who to contact: CEO / Head of US Expansion

Angle: Reference their US-expansion plan and offer a go-to-market localization + US PR launch tied to their $11M seed.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Qureight

heat 76

Trigger: $20M Series B, Tech.eu, as of 29 Jul 2026

Why now: A $20M Series B to expand its AI imaging platform for clinical trials signals hiring and commercial scale-up — fit for recruiting, RevOps and data/dev services.

Who to contact: CEO / VP Commercial · info@qureight.com

Angle: Cite their lung/heart clinical-trial imaging focus and offer specialized regulatory-savvy talent sourcing to support the Series B build-out.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Keiron Printing Technologies

heat 72

Trigger: €20.7M Series A co-led by Invest-NL, DeepTechXL, Waves Capital, EU-Startups, as of 31 Jul 2026

Why now: €20.7M Series A DeepTech round funds team growth and commercialization of its solder-paste printing tech — good fit for recruiting and technical marketing/PR providers.

Who to contact: CEO / Head of Operations · info@keiron.tech

Angle: Lead with the electronics-manufacturing cost problem they solve and offer B2B demand-gen to reach OEM buyers post-Series A.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Centralize (Ryan Williams / private credit AI)

heat 66

Trigger: $10M seed for AI startup for private credit managers, TechCrunch, as of 31 Jul 2026

Why now: (unverified) Repeat founder raised $10M seed to build AI tooling for private credit managers — early team-building phase suited to dev, design and fractional RevOps sellers.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Congratulate on the seed and offer to stand up their first outbound sales stack for asset-manager buyers.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Cascade

heat 58

Trigger: $3.5M seed, TechCrunch, as of 22 Jul 2026

Why now: (unverified) Raised $3.5M to help construction firms find and win projects; a small early team scaling GTM — fit for growth/marketing and dev freelancers, though signal is aging past the 3-week window.

Who to contact: Founder / Head of Growth

Angle: Offer a targeted paid + content playbook to reach construction-firm buyers ahead of their first big sales push.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.

source

Sowilo

heat 52

Trigger: Pre-seed round (amount undisclosed), Tech.eu, as of 21 Jul 2026

Why now: (unverified) Icelandic pre-seed startup expanding an AI-powered fashion product-intelligence platform; early-stage build-out fits dev/design/growth freelancers, but signal is thin and aging.

Who to contact: Founder / CEO

Angle: Reference their fashion product-intelligence niche and offer to build their first conversion-focused website and onboarding flow.

Best-touch window: reach out before ~Aug 31 — the signal decays within weeks.
